commit: # Bytecode-VM track. MUL = bytecode double-and-add (256 iters/multiply).
# Native interpreter is tiny; all EC logic is in 1-byte VM opcodes.
# Baseline is Thomas's ecdsa-p256-verify_stupid.S as received.

note: Thomas Stupid baseline. MUL=bytecode double-and-add. ~27× slower than limb8 890B. 124 B smaller.
op_next subb+jnc replaces cmpb+jne+decb
op_ld/op_st share pop-pop tail via push order
merge skipcs/skipcc via cl==r8b; op_extended preserves cl
op_ok/op_fail direct unwind+ret via cl&1; drop END+check
MAIN modulus deref via cmov (always-read safe in frame)
drop xorl ecx in BEGIN; rcx=0 from entry subq check
bytecode check_zero_mod_m shared tail; check_point falls through
save sig/pub in r10/r11; r9 stays small; drop MAIN xorl r9d
movq rsp REG -> pushq rsp;popq REG for low regs
loop in z256_add/sub; op_add offset 32->30; +63% cyc trade
compute b at runtime from curve equation; slot remap Gx/Gy/B
build p at runtime via stosl; 17 B replaces 32 B data
split p-build around push loop to share xor
build n top half at runtime; fuse with p-build
loop-decode 2-bit table for n_top+p build
1-bit shr/sbb loop for n_top+p; patch d10
dec r9d/jns in op_next instead of sub/jnc
incl instead of movb $1 for ONE init
FAST_Z256 build: dec;jnz in z256_add/sub (+4 B
T8 elim: inline 3*t2 as 3 subs + refactor t0'=3*(t0-t2)
point_add acc=Hx entry: reorder caller copies; drop _LD _Wx
slot 1 = modulus VALUE: drop cmp+cmove; SMOD copies; exit via leaq 1088
modN/modP at slots 30/31: SMOD rdx points directly; drop +64
eliminate op_smod handler: _MODN/_MODP expand to LD/ST bytecode
incl -256 disp32 directly: drop addq that was only for disp8 reach
self-mod z256_addsub: patch adc/sbb byte; merge add+sub into one 14B fn
FAILCC primary op: subsumes SKIPCS/CC+FAIL; ext table 8→5
